items.title: Make review_run_start diagnose signed workspace readiness before reviewer-run creation
items.context: Classify missing git repository, unborn HEAD, missing materialHash, wrong story worktree, and root/worktree mismatch before writing reviewer run metadata. Fail closed when the signed snapshot root and story metadata root would diverge.

happy.desc: From the story worktree for a REVIEW story with a valid git HEAD and materialHash, review_run_start succeeds, prints Review run B-3787:RR-001 started for the requested reviewer lane, persists reviewer-run metadata with the real worktree HEAD/materialHash, and does not report any workspace diagnostic.

edge.desc: When the workspace lacks a usable signed snapshot source such as non-git directory, unborn HEAD, or missing materialHash, review_run_start exits nonzero with a precise diagnostic and concrete next action, and creates no reviewer run metadata or currentReviewRound repair write.

The workspace resolver validates that the canonical ctx.root used for story metadata is the same canonical worktree root used for HEAD/materialHash capture; a mismatch is rejected before snapshot capture or metadata mutation.

adversarial.desc: If process.cwd is the story worktree but the caller passes a root that points at main or another checkout, review_run_start fails closed with a root/worktree mismatch diagnostic and leaves the story file, currentReviewRound, and review-runs collection unchanged.

A stale, placeholder, or otherwise unavailable materialHash cannot be signed into a reviewer run; the handler refuses to create local REVIEW evidence unless HEAD and materialHash are captured from the same verified workspace root.

items.userSees: User sees either Review run B-xxxx:RR-001 started for koala-review-... with a real head prefix, or a fail-closed review_run_start diagnostic naming the missing git/worktree/material context and saying no reviewer run was created.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Build passed and field-regression smoke asserted REVIEW review_run_start success persists real headHash/materialHash and stable reviewRunId.
Smoke covers non-git and unborn HEAD review_run_start failures and asserts no currentReviewRound repair or review-runs write occurs before snapshot readiness.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: resolveStoryCommandWorkspace now canonicalizes ctx.root versus expected worktree root; smoke asserts mismatched LATTICE_PROJECT_ROOT fails before writes.
Smoke runs from story worktree with LATTICE_PROJECT_ROOT pointing at main and asserts root/worktree mismatch plus no reviewer-run write.
diagnoseReviewRunSnapshot refuses missing git HEAD/materialHash before signing; placeholder user hashes are still not accepted for reviewer runs.

items.title: Add regression coverage for non-authority and Authority boundary behavior
items.context: Cover direct REVIEW success in a git-backed worktree, legacy REVIEW missing currentReviewRound repair only after HEAD/materialHash readiness succeeds, non-git/no-commit failure without writes, wrong worktree/root mismatch failure, review_loop placeholder/empty-trigger preservation, and Authority boundary smoke that host output cannot set productionDone/receiptVerified/authorityChanged.

happy.desc: Regression coverage exercises direct REVIEW review_run_start in a git-backed story worktree and asserts the visible success line, stable reviewRunId, persisted run metadata, real HEAD hash, and non-empty materialHash are all present.

edge.desc: Regression coverage proves legacy REVIEW stories missing currentReviewRound are repaired only after snapshot readiness succeeds; non-git, no-commit, and missing-materialHash cases fail without currentReviewRound or review-run writes.

Regression coverage includes wrong worktree and ctx.root/worktree mismatch cases, plus review_loop placeholder and empty-trigger preservation, so diagnostics do not regress unrelated REVIEW entry behavior.

adversarial.desc: Authority boundary smoke proves local host output, local review_run_start success text, and local reviewRunId cannot set productionDone, receiptVerified, or authorityChanged; only an Authority receipt-backed gate decision may do that.
Coverage asserts review_run_start diagnostics describe local signed REVIEW evidence only and never overclaim an Authority Server gate receipt, production completion, or remote approval.

items.userSees: User sees the required smoke commands pass, including field-regression, review-loop, authority-boundary, authority-gate-consumption, and baseline-local-certification checks, with no productionDone/receiptVerified/authorityChanged overclaim from local host output.

verificationEvidence.note: Field regression smoke covers direct REVIEW review_run_start success, reviewRunId output, persisted run metadata, headHash, and materialHash.
Field regression smoke proves legacy REVIEW currentReviewRound repair happens only after snapshot readiness; non-git and no-commit cases leave story and review-runs unchanged.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:review-loop-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Field regression covers wrong cwd and ctx.root/worktree mismatch; review-loop smoke confirms placeholder rollback hash and empty trigger validation still pass.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-boundary-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-gate-consumption && npm --prefix packages/main run test:baseline-local-certification-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Authority boundary, gate-consumption, and baseline-local-certification smoke passed; local host output and local review evidence cannot set productionDone, receiptVerified, or authorityChanged.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:field-regression-cli-smoke && npm --prefix packages/main run test:authority-boundary-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: review_run_start diagnostics remain local signed REVIEW evidence wording only, while Authority boundary smoke pins that no Authority Server gate receipt or production completion is inferred from local output.
